mechanism_narrative: A persistent decline in real GDP growth below its 12-month moving average, coupled with a simultaneous contraction in industrial production, signals weakening aggregate demand that depresses corporate earnings expectations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 60% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between the proxy signal and 20-day returns drops below 0.2 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over a 3-month period signals a tightening monetary cycle that raises discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 60-day returns in more than 50% of triggered instances, or if the signal fails to produce statistically significant negative returns (t-test p > 0.05) over any 5-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over a 6-month period signals labor market weakness that reduces consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If the S&P 500 produces positive 20-day returns in more than 55% of triggered instances, or if the correlation between the proxy signal and 20-day returns drops below 0.15 over any 4-year rolling window.
